description: Add, modify and delete an IPA DNS Record using IPA API.

parameters.name: ipa_host
parameters.description: IP or hostname of IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_HOST is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_HOST and the value are not specified in the task, then DNS is used to try to discover the FreeIPA server. The relevant entry needed in FreeIPA is the ipa-ca entry. If neither the DNS entry, nor the environment IPA_HOST, nor the value are available in the task, then the default value is used. Default: "ipa.example.com"

parameters.name: ipa_pass
parameters.description: Password of administrative user. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PASS is used instead. Note that if the urllib_gssapi library is available, it is possible to use GSSAPI to authenticate to FreeIPA. If the environment variable KRB5CCNAME is available, the module uses this Kerberos credentials cache to authenticate to the FreeIPA server. If the environment variable KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME is available, and KRB5CCNAME is not; the module uses this Kerberos keytab to authenticate. If GSSAPI is not available, the usage of ipa_pass is required.

parameters.name: ipa_port
parameters.description: Port of FreeIPA / IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PORT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PORT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 443

parameters.name: ipa_prot
parameters.description: Protocol used by IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PROT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PROT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: ipa_timeout
parameters.description: Specifies idle timeout (in seconds) for the connection. For bulk operations, you may want to increase this in order to avoid timeout from IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 10

parameters.name: ipa_user
parameters.description: Administrative account used on IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_USER is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_USER and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: "admin"

parameters.name: record_name
parameters.description: The DNS record name to manage.

parameters.name: record_ttl
parameters.description: Set the TTL for the record. Applies only when adding a new or changing the value of record_value or record_values.

parameters.name: record_type
parameters.description: The type of DNS record name. Support for NS was added in comunity.general 8.2.0. Support for SSHFP was added in community.general 9.1.0. Choices: "A" ← (default) "AAAA" "A6" "CNAME" "DNAME" "MX" "NS" "PTR" "SRV" "TXT" "SSHFP"

parameters.name: record_value
parameters.description: Manage DNS record name with this value. Mutually exclusive with record_values, and exactly one of record_value and record_values has to be specified. Use record_values if you need to specify multiple values. In the case of A or AAAA record types, this is the IP address. In the case of A6 record type, this is the A6 Record data. In the case of CNAME record type, this is the hostname. In the case of DNAME record type, this is the DNAME target. In the case of NS record type, this is the name server hostname. Hostname must already have a valid A or AAAA record. In the case of PTR record type, this is the hostname. In the case of TXT record type, this is a text. In the case of SRV record type, this is a service record. In the case of MX record type, this is a mail exchanger record. In the case of SSHFP record type, this is an SSH fingerprint record.

parameters.name: record_values
parameters.description: Manage DNS record name with this value. Mutually exclusive with record_value, and exactly one of record_value and record_values has to be specified. In the case of A or AAAA record types, this is the IP address. In the case of A6 record type, this is the A6 Record data. In the case of CNAME record type, this is the hostname. In the case of DNAME record type, this is the DNAME target. In the case of NS record type, this is the name server hostname. Hostname must already have a valid A or AAAA record. In the case of PTR record type, this is the hostname. In the case of TXT record type, this is a text. In the case of SRV record type, this is a service record. In the case of MX record type, this is a mail exchanger record. In the case of SSHFP record type, this is an SSH fingerprint record.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: This only applies if ipa_prot is https. If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: zone_name
parameters.description: The DNS zone name to which DNS record needs to be managed.

examples:
- name: Ensure dns record is present
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    ipa_host: spider.example.com
    ipa_pass: Passw0rd!
    state: present
    zone_name: example.com
    record_name: vm-001
    record_type: 'AAAA'
    record_value: '::1'

- name: Ensure that dns records exists with a TTL
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    name: host02
    zone_name: example.com
    record_type: 'AAAA'
    record_values: '::1,fe80::1'
    record_ttl: 300
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_pass: topsecret
    state: present

- name: Ensure a PTR record is present
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    ipa_host: spider.example.com
    ipa_pass: Passw0rd!
    state: present
    zone_name: 2.168.192.in-addr.arpa
    record_name: 5
    record_type: 'PTR'
    record_value: 'internal.ipa.example.com'

- name: Ensure a TXT record is present
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    ipa_host: spider.example.com
    ipa_pass: Passw0rd!
    state: present
    zone_name: example.com
    record_name: _kerberos
    record_type: 'TXT'
    record_value: 'EXAMPLE.COM'

- name: Ensure an SRV record is present
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    ipa_host: spider.example.com
    ipa_pass: Passw0rd!
    state: present
    zone_name: example.com
    record_name: _kerberos._udp.example.com
    record_type: 'SRV'
    record_value: '10 50 88 ipa.example.com'

- name: Ensure an MX records are present
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    ipa_host: spider.example.com
    ipa_pass: Passw0rd!
    state: present
    zone_name: example.com
    record_name: '@'
    record_type: 'MX'
    record_values:
      - '1 mailserver-01.example.com'
      - '2 mailserver-02.example.com'

- name: Ensure that dns record is removed
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    name: host01
    zone_name: example.com
    record_type: 'AAAA'
    record_value: '::1'
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret
    state: absent

- name: Ensure an NS record for a subdomain is present
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    name: subdomain
    zone_name: example.com
    record_type: 'NS'
    record_value: 'ns1.subdomain.exmaple.com'
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: ChangeMe!

- name: Retrieve the current sshfp fingerprints
  ansible.builtin.command: ssh-keyscan -D localhost
  register: ssh_hostkeys

- name: Update the SSHFP records in DNS
  community.general.ipa_dnsrecord:
    name: "{{ inventory_hostname}}"
    zone_name: example.com
    record_type: 'SSHFP'
    record_values: "{{ ssh_hostkeys.stdout.split('\n') | map('split', 'SSHFP ') | map('last') | list }}"
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: ChangeMe!

return_values.name: dnsrecord
return_values.description: DNS record as returned by IPA API. Returned: always
